info.text:
OpenAI's revenue pace is $50 billion, not the $70 billion widely reported.
The Financial Times reported Oct 8 that OpenAI told investors its annualized revenue was about $50 billion at the end of September, versus roughly $70 billion widely reported before.
The gap is reportedly mostly about counting: Anthropic counts cloud-partner sales in full (gross), OpenAI counts only its own share (net).
The Nasdaq fell 1.3% on Oct 8, its worst day since mid-August, led by chip stocks.
Sources: Financial Times, CNBC, TechCrunch (Oct 8, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
